card.name: Linking words in patient-group lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words and commas inside lists of patient traits or groups, such as "with" after an age range before a diagnosis, or the comma before "and race". Also fires on a few number or drug-name pieces.

modes.description: The word "with" after an age range, just before a named condition like major depressive disorder.

modes.description: A comma or "in" inside a list of adjustment factors or at-risk groups.
